examples.meaning: to get up, to wake up

kanjiQuiz.q: What is the reading of 質問?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 質問 (しつもん) means 'question' — 質 (quality/substance) + 問 (ask, which you already know).
死 = death/die. 死ぬ is the dictionary form of 'to die'.

kanjiQuiz.q: Which kanji means 'silver', as in ぎんこう (bank)?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 銀 = silver. 銀行 literally means 'silver institution' — a bank.
急 = hurry/sudden. 急に is the adverb form, 'suddenly'.
引 = pull. 割引 (わりびき) literally 'divide-and-pull' → a discount.
働 = work. 働く is the verb 'to work'.

kanjiQuiz.q: Which pair of kanji, read けんきゅう, means 'research'?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 研 (polish/study) + 究 (research) together form 研究, 'research'.
曜 is specifically the kanji used for naming days of the week (月曜日, 火曜日, etc.).
会社 (company) + 員 (member/staff) = 会社員, 'company employee'.

kanjiQuiz.q: Which kanji means 'borrow', as in かりる?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 借 = borrow (借りる). Don't confuse it with 貸 (lend, 貸す) — they look similar but point in opposite directions.

kanjiQuiz.q: びょういん (hospital) and びょうき (illness) share which kanji, and what does it mean?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 病 = sickness/disease. 病院 (hospital) and 病気 (illness) both use it.
有 (exist/have) + 名 (name) = 有名, 'famous' — literally 'having a name'.
知 = know. 知る is the dictionary form of 'to know'.

kanjiQuiz.q: Which kanji is read あたま and means 'head'?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 頭 (あたま) = head. 顔 (かお) is 'face', a different body part kanji covered elsewhere on this list.
広 = wide/spacious. 広い is the い-adjective form.
住 = live/reside. 住む is the dictionary form of 'to live (somewhere)'.

kanjiQuiz.q: Which kanji pair, read うんどう, means 'exercise'?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 運 (carry/luck) + 動 (move) = 運動, 'exercise' — literally 'moving [your body] around'.

kanjiQuiz.q: 軽い is the opposite of which word on this list?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 軽い (かるい, light in weight) is the opposite of 重い (おもい, heavy) — both are common N4 body/luggage-description adjectives.

kanjiQuiz.q: 出発 is read, and means:
kanjiQuiz.ex: 出発 (しゅっぱつ) = departure. Note the small っ that appears when 出 meets 発 — a very common sound change.
地図 (ちず) = map. 地 is チ here, and 図 is ズ — not the ト reading it has in 図書館 (としょかん).
心 (heart) + 配 (distribute) = 心配, 'worry'. 心配しないでください — 'please don't worry' — is worth knowing as a set phrase.
世界 (せかい) = world. Both kanji drop their other readings in this very common compound.
特 (special) + 別 (separate) = 特別, 'special'. You'll see it on menus and train tickets constantly.

kanjiQuiz.q: Which kanji means 'to stop', as in とまる?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 止 = stop. Watch out for 正 (correct) and 上 (up) — they're visually close but unrelated.
お土産 (おみやげ) = souvenir. It's an irregular reading you simply have to memorise as a whole word.
交 (exchange/cross) + 通 (pass through) = 交通, 'traffic/transport'. 交通費 (こうつうひ) is travel expenses.

kanjiQuiz.q: 言葉 is read, and means:
kanjiQuiz.ex: 言葉 (ことば) = word/language. 言 is こと here rather than its usual い(う) or ゲン.
説 (theory/explain) + 明 (clear) = 説明, 'explanation'. 説明書 (せつめいしょ) is an instruction manual.

kanjiQuiz.q: Which is the correct reading of 映画?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 映画 (えいが) = film. 画 is ガ here; in 画面 (がめん, screen) it's also ガ, but in 計画 (けいかく, plan) it's カク.

kanjiQuiz.q: 到着 and 着る share 着. What does 着 cover?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 着 spans both senses: 到着 (とうちゃく, arrival) / 着く (つく, to arrive) and 着る (きる, to wear). Same kanji, two jobs — a classic N4 trap.

kanjiQuiz.q: 予定 vs 予約 — which one means 'reservation'?
kanjiQuiz.ex: 予約 (よやく) = reservation/booking; 予定 (よてい) = plan/schedule. 予 ('in advance') is shared, so keep the second kanji in mind.
足 is 'foot' but also 'sufficient'. 足りる (たりる) = to be enough; お金が足りません is 'I don't have enough money'.
